manifest.name: dsh-req-capture
manifest.description: Diagnostic plugin: wraps global fetch to log requests and capture bodies whose URL matches a configurable substring to disk.
manifest.author: r-ayin

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch layer for dsh-req-capture (临时诊断).
- insert:
    - id: dsh-req-capture
      name: dsh-req-capture

readme.text:
Diagnostic plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It wraps the host's global `fetch` to log outgoing requests and capture matching request bodies to disk for offline analysis (for example, diffing LLM request payloads when debugging cache-hit differences).

No UI, no tools.

| env | meaning | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH` | URL substring; bodies of requests whose URL contains it are written to the capture dir | empty (capture nothing, log only) |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_DIR` | capture directory | `/tmp/dsh-req-capture` |

Every fetch call is logged to `<dir>/fetch-log.txt` (timestamp, method, truncated URL, body size); matching bodies are written as `req-<ts>-<seq>.json`. A self-probe fetch runs once on apply to verify the wrapper is live in the host realm.

> **Warning** — captured bodies are raw request payloads and may contain prompt content. Treat the capture directory as sensitive and delete it when done.
Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
